issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'Test Entry FT1' (count went from 5 to 6 entries, visible in table). After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6074/, entry count reverted to 5 and 'Test Entry FT1' was no longer present in the table.
evidence: statusbar.count was '6 entries' before reload, '5 entries' after; entries.table items list no longer contains entry-1787699886521-v8wg3iuxf after reload.

Added field 'Notes' (type Number) via Fields dialog; it appeared as a sortable column in table view, as an observable item in card view (entries.cards itemControls), in the sort dropdown options, and as a number input in the Add Entry form.

Created entry with text 'Test Entry FT3', number 7, date 2026-10-05 (displayed as 'Oct 5, 2026'), checkbox checked (displayed 'Yes' in cards, check icon in table). Values shown identically in both table and card views.
Switched from card view to table view (and back); all 6 entries and their field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical across both views.

Entries without a Notes value show '—' consistently in both table view (entries.table.item.entry-1.field-*.value) and card view (entries.cards.item.entry-1.field-*.value). All configured fields (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) appear for every entry in both views with matching values.

Table view: checked entries show a green check icon (lucide-check, text-success), unchecked show a muted X icon (lucide-x, text-muted-foreground). Card view: checked shows 'Yes', unchecked shows 'No'. Entry form uses a toggle switch control (entry.field-4) with distinct true/false states.

Field-config type select shows clearly labeled options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Entry form renders type-appropriate native controls: field-1 <input type=text>, field-2 <input type=number>, field-3 <input type=date>, field-4 <button role=checkbox> toggle.

Priority (Number) field renders as native <input type=number>. Attempting to type 'abc' into it was rejected by the browser itself ('Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), and numeric values (4, 7, 42, 99) were accepted and saved correctly in earlier entries.

Due Date field is a native <input type=date>. Setting an invalid date string '2026-13-45' resulted in the input value being rejected/cleared to '' by the browser's native date parsing. Valid dates (2026-09-01, 2026-10-05) were accepted and saved/displayed correctly (e.g. 'Sep 1, 2026').

Sorted table view by Priority (asc then desc via header click) - order changed correctly (1,1,2,2,3,7 asc; 7,3,2,2,1,1 desc). Switched to card view: sort reset to unselected 'Sort', set Task Name ascending there. Switching back to table view retained 'Sorted by Priority (descending)' unaffected by card view's sort, confirming independent per-view sort state.

Selecting 'Priority' in the sort dropdown immediately reordered rows and statusbar.sort displayed 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'; clicking the column header toggled to 'Sorted by Priority (descending)' and reordered again. App remained fully usable (other controls responsive) after each sort action.

Before and after sorting (ascending/descending by Priority, and by Task Name in card view), entry count remained '6 entries' and each entry's field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) were unchanged - only row order changed.

With no field sort active, dragged entry-1's drag handle onto entry-3 in table view -> order became [entry-2,entry-3,entry-1,entry-4,entry-5,new]. Separately dragged entry-1 onto entry-3 in card view -> same result there. Then dragged entry-4 to top in table view only -> table order became [entry-4,entry-2,entry-3,entry-1,entry-5,new] while card view retained its own order [entry-2,entry-3,entry-1,entry-4,entry-5,new] unchanged after switching, proving independent manual order per view.

issue: No filter feature exists in the app
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, table headers, card view, and full page DOM for any filter control (button, icon, or panel). No 'Filter' text, no funnel/filter icon (lucide-filter), and no filter-related data-semtag elements were found anywhere. Only Sort, Search, view toggles, Add Entry, and Fields controls exist. There is no way to define field-specific filter criteria.
evidence: Full-page innerHTML search for the substring 'filter' returned no matches; enumerated all SVG icon classes on the page (database, settings2, search, arrow-up-down, table2, layout-grid, plus, grip-vertical, x, pencil, trash2, check) - none related to filtering.

issue: No filter feature exists to test inclusion/exclusion or clearing
actual: No filter UI is present anywhere in the app (toolbar, table headers, card view). Since there is no way to define filter criteria, the app cannot include/exclude entries by criteria or provide a 'clear filters' action to verify.
evidence: Same DOM search as FT-6: no filter-related elements or icons found.

Searching 'landing' filtered to 1 matching entry ('Design new landing page'), statusbar showed '1 entry matching \"landing\"'. Searching uppercase 'LANDING' produced the identical single-match result, confirming case-insensitivity. Clicking clear-search button restored statusbar to '6 entries' with all entries visible again.

issue: Search matches only raw internal values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching for the displayed due-date text 'Jan 15' (as shown 'Jan 15, 2026' in both views) returned '0 entries matching', while searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-15' returned '1 entry matching'. Searching the displayed checkbox label 'Yes' (shown in card view) returned '0 entries matching' even though 2 entries are checked/'Yes'.
evidence: statusbar.count values: 'Jan 15' -> '0 entries matching \"Jan 15\"'; '2026-01-15' -> '1 entry matching \"2026-01-15\"'; 'Yes' -> '0 entries matching \"Yes\"'.

issue: No import feature exists in the app
actual: The Fields configuration dialog only contains a note stating 'Configure fields before importing data', but there is no actual import button, file picker, or data-paste control anywhere in the dialog or the rest of the app. A full-page HTML search for 'import' only found this note text, no functional import control. Therefore importing data and validating type-mismatch rejection cannot be performed.
evidence: fields.dialog snapshot contains only field rows, a New-field name/type/Add control, the note paragraph, and Close button - no import action.
